messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "stop use and ask doctor if have or come into contact with chickenpox, measles, or tuberculosis"
set: ["stop use and ask doctor if have or come into contact with chickenpox, measles, or tuberculosis", "ask doctor before use if pregnant or breastfeeding", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have trouble or pain with swallowing", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions", "ask doctor or pharmacist if unsure how to use injection", "tuberculosis", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have liver disease", "contact your doctor", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have nausea or vomiting, stomach pain", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have frequent chest pain, heartburn with wheezing", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have unexplained weight loss", "tell doctor if have or had pregnancy", "tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you need help", "stop using and tell doctor if pregnant", "tell doctor if have or had bipolar disorder or mania"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
